newsitem.title: PANAMA: Port conditions update - Panama - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Panama - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BALBOA, May 9 - The Local Chamber of Shipping issued the following statement: It has come to the Camara's attention rumours that a segment of the pilot force, prompted by grievances with the administration, are apparently making a job action or work to rule. We believe 43 vessels were scheduled for transit yesterday, yet only 34 vessels could transit. It is our understanding there are urgent meetings taking place today, within the commission, but, as the situation stands, it is difficult to predict when the present backlog will cleared.
